title: Scone: Symmetry-aware Neural Combinatorial Optimization for Graph Coloring
abstract: arXiv:2611.25273v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph coloring, which entails assigning colors to nodes such that no adjacent nodes have the same color, is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem. In general, however, finding a node coloring with no monochromatic edges given a fixed palette is NP-hard. This motivates learning-based methods that can learn to exploit recurring structure across instances to efficiently produce high-quality colorings. Crucially, the validity of a coloring is invariant to permutations of the colors, and we show that exploiting this symmetry reduces the size of the effective state space over which the model has to learn its policy. At the same time, the coloring algorithm must be able to break some symmetries, for example to assign different colors to two adjacent nodes belonging to the same automorphism orbit. translated_title: Scone：面向图着色的对称性感知神经组合优化
translated_abstract: 图着色是指为节点分配颜色使得相邻节点颜色互不相同的问题，是一个基础的组合优化问题。然而，在给定固定调色板的情况下，找到不含有单色边的节点着色方案是NP难的。这促使人们研究基于学习的方法，这类方法能够学习利用实例间反复出现的结构，从而高效地生成高质量着色方案。至关重要的是，一个着色方案的有效性对颜色置换具有不变性，我们证明利用这种对称性可以缩小模型学习策略时所需的有效状态空间的规模。与此同时，着色算法还必须能够打破某些对称性，例如为属于同一自同构轨道的两个相邻节点分配不同的颜色。本文提出了Scone，一个使用颜色等变图神经网络顺序构建着色方案的模型，能够……
tldr: 本文提出Scone，一种基于颜色等变图神经网络的对称性感知神经组合优化方法，通过利用颜色置换对称性缩小状态空间并在必要时打破对称性，从而高效构建高质量的图着色方案。
en_tdlr: Scone is a symmetry-aware neural combinatorial optimization model that uses a color-equivariant graph neural network to exploit color permutation symmetry while breaking symmetries when needed, enabling efficient construction of high-quality graph colorings.
